name: Ochiai
tagline: Shinjuku in 15 minutes and Otemachi in 19 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Nakano City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 19 minutes to Otemachi, 15 minutes to Shinjuku, 23 minutes to Shibuya and 39 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 30.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 16.2 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 30.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 18.2 m to 34.4 m, a difference of 16.2 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 5 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 19 clinics and 16 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 近藤泌尿器科内科クリニック, about 9 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 菖医院, about 14 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Tozai Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Tozai Line runs at 160% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 木場→門前仲町, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

Whether it faces a main road or the railway

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is among the lowest in the 23 wards. What holds the figure down: only one line, the {line}, serving the station. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For rail connections, Nakai; for the number of medical facilities, Ochiai.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Ochiai. Nakai also has the Seibu Shinjuku Line and Toei Oedo Line, which Ochiai does not. With more lines, Nakai is the better connected of the two. To Roppongi, for instance, Nakai is 10 minutes quicker. On how easy the shopping is, though, Ochiai comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For rail connections, Higashi-Nakano; for quiet, Ochiai.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Ochiai. Higashi-Nakano also has the JR Chuo-Sobu Line (Local) and Toei Oedo Line, which Ochiai does not. With more lines, Higashi-Nakano is the better connected of the two. To Roppongi, for instance, Higashi-Nakano is 12 minutes quicker. On quiet, though, Ochiai comes out ahead.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want a park close by
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: The 首都高速中央環状線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
早稲田通り (1 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 12 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Tozai Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
